items.title: Modules on a closed subspace are exactly the modules killed by the ideal of the immersion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the module category of a closed subspace with the full subcategory of modules on the ambient space annihilated by the ideal of the immersion, the direct image functor being exact and fully faithful (author lemma at source lines 2162-2177, label lemma-i-star-equivalence). The proof (source lines 2179-2220) checks the unit of the adjunction on stalks, which gives full faithfulness, and then checks the counit on stalks for a module annihilated by the ideal, splitting into the points outside the closed subset, where both modules vanish, and the points of the closed subset, where the module of the subspace is realised as a quotient of the local ring (proof lines 2180-2220). Both stalk computations are the content. H3.
